comment: The time knob has two CV jacks sharing one attenuverter: one continuous and one sampled and held on each step of the clock. The mode and rhythm CV jacks both span their whole list over ten volts and wrap, so an oscillator sweeps the machine without trimming; a small attenuverter setting picks between two neighbouring modes instead. Mode changes from CV wait for the next clock step by default, so a modulated change lands on the beat. The two pattern switches are each normalled to the jack below them. The euclidean half of the rhythm list skips six densities because at sixteen steps those are patterns the hand-written half already holds. The module is built after Bastl Instruments' Citadel FX Wizard, and its bottom half is the same circuit as vates's. The panel prints artifex, fx mode, time, feedback, amount, free, step, filter, stereo, trig, tempo, clk, sync, rate, mod, reset, pwm, env, tri, saw, pulse, rhythm, gate ptrn, cv ptrn, reset, gate, cv, clk, gain, in, level and out.
